tvShows.name: Hui Gumm Yaadein - Ek Doctor, Do Zindagiyaan
tvShows.description: Hui Gumm Yaadein - Ek Doctor, Do Zindagiyaan follows Dr. Dev's journey after losing eight years of memory. Watch this emotional family & romantic drama with love, resilience & rediscovery. Starring Iqbal Khan, Gulki Joshi & Srishti Singh
